name: SAP S/4HANA Consultant / Developer
title: SAP S/4HANA Consultant / Developer
description: Mastery of SAP S/4HANA architecture, simplified data structures, Universal Journal, Business Partner concept, cross-functional module integration (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM), Clean Core extensibility paradigm, and migration cockpit.
prerequisites: General understanding of enterprise finance & logistics

levels.title: Level 0 — S/4HANA Architecture & Simplified Data Model
levels.description: Evolution to in-memory computing, table elimination (BSIS, BSAS, BSEG -> ACDOCA, MATDOC), and architectural principles.

subjects.title: S/4HANA Core Data Model
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering S/4HANA Core Data Model.

topics.title: In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions
topics.description: Understand how HANA column store enabled table elimination, aggregate removal, and real-time processing.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions

learningItems.title: Traditional ERP Aggregate and Index Tables vs S/4HANA Columnar Architecture
Universal Journal Table (ACDOCA): Merging FI and CO Single Source of Truth
Material Document Table (MATDOC): Simplifying Inventory Management
Simplification List & Release Differences across S/4HANA Versions (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
Compatibility Views & Redirects for Legacy Custom Code

practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where In-Memory Computing & Table Reductions throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.
